elements.label: Figure S3.1
elements.title: Establishment of national standards bodies began earlier in high-income countries than in low- and middle-income countries
elements.content: Chart type: Line chart. Panel title: Cumulative number of countries. Y-axis: Cumulative number of countries from 0 to 45 (increments of 5). X-axis: Year national standards body was established from 1875 to 2025 (increments of 25). Legend/Series names: High income, Upper middle income, Lower middle income, Low income. Trends and approx. values by 2025: High income reaches highest cumulative count (approx. 41), followed by Upper middle income (approx. 34), Lower middle income (approx. 28), and Low income (approx. 13). Source: WDR 2025 team, based on World Bank and ISO 2025. Note: The survey sample includes 116 national standards bodies: 13 in low-income countries, 28 in lower-middle-income countries, 34 in upper-middle-income countries, and 41 in high-income countries.
